clue.text: Small guard required for small piece of carpet

parts.note: S is the standard abbreviation for small
to keep watch is to stand guard; a watch is also a guard on duty

explanation.surface: Someone small is needed to stand watch over a scrap of carpet.
explanation.definitionFit: A swatch is a sample cut from fabric or carpet so a buyer can judge colour and texture.

clue.text: Kind hearts absent in brief

indicators.note: something absent is missing, so the named card suit letter is taken out

parts.note: brief and short are synonyms
H is the card-game abbreviation for hearts

explanation.surface: A short note about a kind person who has no heart.
explanation.walkthrough: SHORT loses its H to leave SORT.
explanation.definitionFit: Kind and sort are synonyms as nouns meaning a type or category of thing.

clue.text: A quiet fielder put in position

parts.note: taken as written
p (piano) is the musical marking for quiet
point is a cricket fielding position, and the fielder stationed there

explanation.surface: A cricket captain sets a silent fielder in their place.
explanation.walkthrough: Point is a fielding position square of the batter on the off side in cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: To appoint someone is to assign them a post or role, placing them officially in a position.

clue.text: Scoundrel among performers with a bit of oomph is performer missing something

parts.note: the cast is the set of actors in a show
a rat is a contemptible, treacherous person

indicators.note: a bit is only a small portion, here just the opening letter of the following word

parts.note: the opening letter of oomph

explanation.surface: A villain in the cast, together with a dash of energy, describes some flawed stage performer.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is wry: a castrato was a male singer castrated before puberty to keep a high voice.
explanation.definitionFit: Castrati were male singers who lacked testes, so 'missing something' is a coy description of their condition.

clue.text: Players beginning to drink liquor? Just one in the percussion section

definitions.text: Just one in the percussion section

parts.note: a side is a team of players

rum is a spirit, a kind of liquor

explanation.surface: Musicians start drinking spirits, though only one of the percussionists does.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads as a comment on the drinkers, but it simply names one instrument found among the percussion.
explanation.definitionFit: A side drum, or snare drum, is a small two-headed drum that is one instrument among several in an orchestra's percussion.

clue.text: As it happens, that is accommodating new symbol of nationalist tirade

indicators.note: to accommodate is to give room to, so the outer abbreviation holds the rest inside it

parts.note: i.e. abbreviates id est, 'that is'
N is the standard abbreviation for new
a national flag is the emblem a nationalist rallies round
a rant is a loud angry tirade

explanation.surface: Someone is caught flag-waving and ranting in a nationalist outburst as it happens.
explanation.walkthrough: The Latin phrase means 'in blazing' and describes being caught in the very act.
explanation.definitionFit: In flagrante (delicto) means caught red-handed, in the act of wrongdoing, so while it is actually happening.

clue.text: Member of syndicate wearing the Spanish coat

indicators.note: the article is worn around the member like clothing, so it surrounds the word

parts.note: el is the Spanish word for the
a Name is an individual underwriting member of a Lloyd's of London syndicate

explanation.surface: A syndicate member dons a Spanish-style coat.
explanation.walkthrough: Lloyd's of London is the British insurance market, whose individual backers are called Names.
explanation.definitionFit: Enamel is a glossy protective coating, whether paint, a fused glass layer on metal, or the coat on teeth.

clue.text: Podcast's studied expensive target of hunters?

indicators.note: a podcast is heard rather than seen, so what follows is judged by its sound

dear means costly, sounding like the animal

explanation.surface: A podcast has examined something costly that hunters aim at.
explanation.walkthrough: Read dear, said out loud, gives the name of the large British deer species.
explanation.definitionFit: The red deer is a large wild deer long stalked as game, so it is a classic quarry for hunters.

clue.text: Stuns room, misbehaving: outrageous

indicators.note: letters that misbehave will not stay in their proper places, so they get rearranged

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Bad behaviour shocks everyone in the room into silence: scandalous.
explanation.definitionFit: Monstrous and outrageous are synonyms meaning shockingly wrong or unacceptable.

clue.text: Stop eating father's food

indicators.note: whatever eats something takes it inside, so one word swallows another

parts.note: a rest is a stop or pause
pa is an informal name for father

explanation.surface: An order to stop eating Dad's dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: PA goes inside REST; the ’s stands for 'is', joining wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A repast is a meal, a formal or literary word for a serving of food.

clue.text: Old Fellows with a new lecturer? Not all the time

parts.note: O is a standard abbreviation for old
F abbreviates fellow, doubled for the plural
taken as written
N is the standard abbreviation for new
a don is a university teacher

explanation.surface: Elderly college fellows with a newly appointed lecturer, who doesn't always turn up.
explanation.definitionFit: Off and on means intermittently, now and then, rather than continuously.

clue.text: Help pair out with adhesive for operation

indicators.note: a pair who are out of order or out of sorts are disarranged, so their letters are reworked

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged
cement is a binding glue or paste

explanation.surface: A plea for help getting a couple out, with glue needed for some procedure.
explanation.walkthrough: Surgeons often fix an artificial hip joint in place with bone cement, so the surface is apt.
explanation.definitionFit: A hip replacement is a surgical procedure swapping a damaged hip joint for an artificial one.

clue.text: Those against scabs covering scar in nippers

indicators.note: something covering another lies over and around it, so the outer word encloses the inner

parts.note: strikers on a picket line oppose scabs, workers who cross it
a pock is a pit or scar left on the skin, as by smallpox

explanation.surface: Strikers hostile to scabs hide their scars in tiny children.
explanation.walkthrough: Nipper is British slang for a small child, which is the false trail; it also means a petty thief.
explanation.definitionFit: Nipper is old slang for a petty thief, one who nips or pinches wallets from people's pockets.

clue.text: European figures about return of competition vehicles

parts.note: E is the standard abbreviation for European

indicators.note: a return goes back the way it came, so the word is read from right to left
about means around, so the outer word wraps round the turned word

parts.note: stats is short for statistics, sets of figures
a race is a competition of speed

explanation.surface: Continental statistics about the return of a sporting contest.
explanation.walkthrough: Estate car is the British term for a station wagon.
explanation.definitionFit: Estate cars are motor cars with an extended rear load area, a kind of vehicle.

clue.text: Members of Biblical flock, as in 'sheep', possibly

indicators.note: possibly hints at one of several possible arrangements of the letters

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Church members described as sheep, in the familiar flock image of a congregation.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ephesians were the Christian congregation at Ephesus to whom Paul's epistle is addressed.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ephesians formed an early Christian church, a flock in the pastoral sense, named in the Bible.

clue.text: Classic ship in the past seen around river

indicators.note: something seen around another surrounds it, so the river abbreviation goes inside

parts.note: ago means in the past
R is the standard abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: An old ship was once seen near a river.
explanation.walkthrough: R sits inside AGO. Classic here means from classical Greek myth.
explanation.definitionFit: The Argo was the ship of Jason and the Argonauts in Greek mythology, the classics' famous vessel.

clue.text: Prison leading famous people to develop pseudonyms

parts.note: pen is short for penitentiary, a prison
big names are celebrities

explanation.surface: A jail heads up celebrities who go on to adopt aliases.
explanation.definitionFit: Pen names are pseudonyms adopted by writers in place of their real names.

clue.text: Woman's throttling a judge

indicators.note: throttling grips something round the neck, so the outer word closes around the article

parts.note: her is the possessive for a woman
taken as written

explanation.surface: A woman is strangling a judge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Judge' looks like the victim of the throttling, but it is the definition, used as a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To hear a case is to try it in court, so hear and judge are near synonyms as legal verbs.

clue.text: Emergency aid? One international link initially filling gap

indicators.note: a filling sits inside something, so this letter is put into the word for gap

I is an abbreviation for international
a rift is a crack or gap

indicators.note: initially means at the start, so only the opening letter of the previous word is used

parts.note: the opening letter of link

explanation.surface: Global connections plugging a shortfall in urgent relief.
explanation.walkthrough: L goes into RIFT after its first letter, preceded by A and I.
explanation.definitionFit: An airlift transports supplies by aircraft, typically in an emergency when land routes are cut off.

clue.text: Cadge trousers — they're useful for travellers

parts.note: to sponge is to cadge, scrounging off others
bags is dated British slang for loose trousers

explanation.surface: Borrowing someone's trousers for a trip.
explanation.walkthrough: A sponge bag is the British name for a toiletry bag, a washbag.
explanation.definitionFit: Sponge bags are waterproof washbags carrying toiletries, packed by travellers on trips away.

clue.text: Invalidate second and third of marriages with a ring

parts.note: to annul is to declare void

parts.note: the letters in second and third place of marriages

explanation.walkthrough: Annul is the legal word for invalidating a marriage, which drives the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Annular means ring-shaped, describing something formed with or like a ring.

clue.text: Very, very good to reside in pub, but pointless

indicators.note: residing in a place means living inside it, so these letters go within the pub word

parts.note: an inn is a pub
V is the abbreviation for very
A1 means first-class, with the 1 written as I

explanation.surface: Living in a pub may be wonderful, but it achieves nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 was the top grade in Lloyd's Register of ships, hence excellent, and is written AI in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: In vain means without success or to no purpose, so an effort made in vain is pointless.

clue.text: Spa's constant inclination for annual overhaul?

parts.note: a spa is a mineral spring
c is the symbol for a constant, such as the speed of light
a leaning is a tendency or inclination

explanation.surface: A health resort's ongoing bent towards a yearly refit.
explanation.definitionFit: Spring-cleaning is a thorough top-to-bottom clean of a house traditionally done once a year, hence an annual overhaul.

clue.text: Broadcaster finally dodging broadcast trouble

indicators.note: a letter dodging a word avoids it, so it is left out

parts.note: to broadcast seed is to scatter or strew it

indicators.note: finally points to the end, so only the closing letter of the previous word is used

parts.note: the closing letter of broadcaster

explanation.surface: A broadcaster at last escapes trouble over a programme.
explanation.walkthrough: STREW without its R. 'Broadcast' first reads as radio, but here it means sown by scattering.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in a stew means being in a state of anxiety or difficulty, so stew means trouble.

clue.text: Galvanises return of vigour with injection of energy

parts.note: stamina is staying power, vigour

explanation.surface: An energy jab brings back someone's vigour, rousing them.
explanation.definitionFit: To galvanise is to shock or stir into action, and to animate is to bring life and liveliness to.

clue.text: American satisfied about University lecturer's charm

indicators.note: about means around, so the word for satisfied goes round the next letters

parts.note: A is an abbreviation for American
a need that is met has been satisfied
U is an abbreviation for university
L is an abbreviation for lecturer

explanation.surface: A contented American enthuses over a college lecturer's personal charm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Charm' suggests personal appeal, but it is a lucky object. U and L go inside MET, after A.
explanation.definitionFit: An amulet is a charm worn as a protection against evil or misfortune, a talisman.

clue.text: Ain't Mass traduced in this?

indicators.note: something traduced is misrepresented, twisted out of its true form, so the letters are reworked

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged, apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: A question whether the Mass is slandered in some cult.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: the Black Mass of satanism parodies and mocks the Christian Mass.
explanation.definitionFit: Satanism's black mass is a deliberate travesty of the Catholic Mass, so the Mass is maligned within it.

clue.text: Key argument in computer encryption process

parts.note: Esc is the escape key on a computer keyboard
a row is a quarrel

explanation.surface: A dispute over a key in some cryptography system.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Key' looks like a cipher key from the definition, but it is a keyboard key.
explanation.definitionFit: Key escrow is a scheme where decryption keys are lodged with a trusted third party, an arrangement used in encryption.
